articles.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
articles.excerpt: AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. It’s a path toward coding agents that learn not only how to solve tasks, but also how to spend computation more effectively. The post TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient appeared first on Microsoft Research.
articles.context: Relevant to AI systems that take actions, including coding and computer-use workflows.
